config.launchBody: Explore key features and workflows in this interactive walkthrough.

steps.title: Welcome to Qlytics Dashboard
steps.body: Get a quick overview of your recent activity and key metrics here.

steps.title: Understand Tech Transfer
steps.body: This section allows you to upload and manage your source files for data transfer.

steps.title: Review Total Requests
steps.body: See a summary of all your data transfer requests, including their approval status.

steps.title: View Transfer Request List
steps.body: Browse through all your existing data transfer requests with details like status and creation date.

steps.title: Initiate a New Request
steps.body: Click here to start the process of creating a new data transfer request.

steps.title: Start New Transfer Request
steps.body: This dialog guides you through the steps to set up your data transfer.

steps.title: Enter Request Name
steps.body: Provide a descriptive name for your new transfer request.

steps.title: Select Source System
steps.body: Choose the origin system for your data transfer.

steps.title: Select Target System
steps.body: Specify the destination system where the data will be transferred.

steps.title: Proceed to File Upload
steps.body: Click 'Proceed' to move to the next step: uploading your source files.

steps.title: Upload Source Files
steps.body: You are now in the file upload stage of your transfer request.

steps.title: Drag & Drop or Select File
steps.body: Upload your primary source file by dragging it here or clicking to browse.

steps.title: Add Additional Files (Optional)
steps.body: If needed, upload any supplementary files for your transfer.

steps.title: Choose Mapping Option: New
steps.body: Select this option to create a new data mapping for your files.

steps.title: Choose Mapping Option: Existing
steps.body: Select this option to apply an existing mapping template to your files.

steps.title: Proceed to Mapping
steps.body: Click 'Proceed' to configure or apply your data mapping.

steps.title: Review Uploaded Files
steps.body: Verify the files you've uploaded before generating a preview.

steps.title: Source File Details
steps.body: Here you can see the details of your uploaded source file, 'sink_order_sample.json'.

steps.title: Generate Data Preview
steps.body: Click to generate a preview of how your data will look after mapping.

steps.title: Switch to Table View
steps.body: View your data preview in a structured table format.

steps.title: Switch to JSON View
steps.body: View your data preview in raw JSON format.

steps.title: Data Preview (Table)
steps.body: This table displays a preview of your mapped data, showing columns like order_id and customer_first_name.

steps.title: Data Preview (JSON)
steps.body: This section shows the raw JSON output of your mapped data.

steps.title: Finalize Preview
steps.body: Once you've reviewed the data, click 'Proceed' to continue.

steps.title: Assign Reviewer
steps.body: Select a reviewer who will approve or reject this transfer request.

steps.title: Assign Approver
steps.body: Select an approver who will give final authorization for the transfer.

steps.title: Add Comments (Optional)
steps.body: Provide any additional notes or instructions for the reviewer and approver.

steps.title: Submit Transfer Request
steps.body: Click 'Submit Request' to send your data transfer request for review and approval.

steps.title: View Submitted Request
steps.body: Your newly submitted request, 'test', is now visible in the transfer list.

:root { --demostudio-accent: #3b82f6; --demostudio-card-bg: #ffffff; --demostudio-card-text: #1c2333; --demostudio-card-muted: #5b6474; --demostudio-dim: rgba(13, 22, 38, 0.55); }

Q

qhuser

Welcome Back, qhuser!

Select a tool to transform, transfer, or analyze your data using Generative AI.

Query Converter

Write your query once and let our intelligent converter handle the rest. Instantly transform SQL between multiple databases, eliminate manual rewrites, and keep your workflow smooth and error-free.

Tech Transfer

Upload your source files and optionally guide the process with a mapping JSON. Add context and select approvers, then send your request for approval.

Mapping Template

Manage data mapping templates for aligning input data with target structures. Enable accurate and reliable data transfers across integrations.

Talk to your Data

Query your datasets using natural language and receive structured, reliable insights in seconds.
